# opnsense_nginx_cache_path (Data Source)

nginx cache paths (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ HTTP(S) ▸ Cache Path**, plugin `os-nginx`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx cache path.

### Read-Only

- `inactive` (Number) Inactive Time (Minutes).
- `max_size` (Number) Maximum Size (GB).
- `path` (String) Path.
- `size` (Number) Size (MB).
- `use_temp_path` (Boolean) Use Temp Path.
